psychological_meaning: Scarlett, a vibrant and intense red, evokes feelings of passion, courage, and excitement. It is a color that commands attention and can symbolize power, ambition, and determination. However, it can also be associated with anger, danger, and aggression. Its boldness often makes it linked to love and romance, as well as strong emotional reactions.
